# Qualitate

Qualitate is a Technology, Information and Internet company. Qualitate is an AI-powered expert intelligence platform that deploys intelligent AI moderators to conduct expert-driven conversations at scale. Qualitate employs 42 people, founded in 2024. Headquartered in New York, New York, United States. Its workforce is distributed across United States and United Kingdom.

## About

Qualitate delivers real-time expert intelligence for investment and strategy teams. 

Our AI moderator powers the full primary research workflow, from study design and expert recruitment to interview moderation and insight creation. 

Built for enterprises, Qualitate offers a full suite of products, including moderated calls, transcript libraries, analyst research, market & company intelligence, and productivity tools.

Trusted by the world’s largest investment funds and corporations, Qualitate equips every company with the world’s most valuable asset: expert intelligence.
